# Registry configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-config-reference.py from Terrakube origin/main. Do not edit by hand. -->

Environment variables of the Terrakube **Registry**. See [Configuration Reference](README.md) for how to set them. An empty default means the variable has no default: either it is optional or it must be provided.

### /.well-known/terraform.json Data

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AzBuilderRegistry` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.hostname`. |
| `AppClientId` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.clientId`. |
| `AppIssuerUri` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.issuerUri`. |
| `TerraformLoginEnabled` | `false` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.login-broker-enabled`. |
| `TerraformLoginApiUrl` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.login-api-url`. |

### AZURE Storage

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AzureAccountName` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.azure.accountName`. |
| `AzureAccountKey` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.azure.accountKey`. |
| `AzureBlobPresignedUrlExpirySeconds` | `300` | Azure Blob module.zip presigned SAS redirect - off by default for staged rollout; also the rollback switch back to the registry proxying ZIP bytes. |

### AWS Storage

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AwsStorageAccessKey` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.accessKey`. |
| `AwsStorageSecretKey` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.secretKey`. |
| `AwsStorageBucketName` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.bucketName`. |
| `AwsStorageRegion` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.region`. |
| `AwsEndpoint` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.endpoint`. |
| `AwsEnableRoleAuth` | `false` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.enableRoleAuthentication`. |
| `AwsEndpointRegion` | `auto` | S3-compatible backends (Qumulo, MinIO, ...) that need a real signing region or no chunked/checksum support |
| `AwsPathStyleAccess` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.pathStyleAccessEnabled`. |
| `AwsChunkedEncodingEnabled` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.chunkedEncodingEnabled`. |
| `AwsChecksumValidationEnabled` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.checksumValidationEnabled`. |
| `AwsS3ConnectionAcquisitionTimeoutSeconds` | `1` | S3Client/S3Presigner HTTP client bounds - fail fast rather than queue request threads against a slow or unreachable S3 endpoint. Defaults match the module-download resilience design. |
| `AwsS3ConnectTimeoutSeconds` | `2` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.connectTimeoutSeconds`. |
| `AwsS3SocketTimeoutSeconds` | `10` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.socketTimeoutSeconds`. |
| `AwsS3ApiCallAttemptTimeoutSeconds` | `15` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.apiCallAttemptTimeoutSeconds`. |
| `AwsS3ApiCallTimeoutSeconds` | `25` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.apiCallTimeoutSeconds`. |
| `AwsS3MaxConnections` | `50` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.maxConnections`. |
| `AwsS3PresignedUrlExpirySeconds` | `300` | module.zip presigned redirect - off by default for staged rollout; also the rollback switch back to the registry proxying ZIP bytes. |
| `AwsS3PresignedRedirectEnabled` | `false` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.plugin.storage.aws.presignedRedirectEnabled`. |

### MODULE REGISTRY CACHE

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ModuleVersionsCacheTtlSeconds` | `600` | Time to live of the module version list. This is the delay between the API storing a new module version and the registry serving it, so lower it when modules are released often. |

### DOWNLOAD COUNT UPDATE

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DownloadCountExecutorCorePoolSize` | `2` | Bounded pool for the best-effort download-count bookkeeping call, kept off the Terraform-facing metadata response's critical path - see DownloadCountExecutorConfig. |
| `DownloadCountExecutorMaxPoolSize` | `5` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.download-count.executor.maxPoolSize`. |
| `DownloadCountExecutorQueueCapacity` | `200` | Sets `io.terrakube.registry.download-count.executor.queueCapacity`. |
